title: Hearty Rich Greek Lamb Stew
description: A rich and tender one-pot Greek dish featuring lamb, rich flavors, and a hearty serving of comfort food, made with lard for added depth and fold in fresh herbs for a dash of freshness.
instructions: Heat the lard in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the browned lamb from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it is lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the dried oregano, tomato paste, red wine, and chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot.
Return the browned lamb to the pot and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and simmer for 2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Stir in the chopped parsley, salt, and black pepper.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
